items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Gus was with us. Gus Miller, he was with us. At the Inn and down at the Ambassador.

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't even know where it was.

Yeah, on Santa Monica. The bus estate, the Anheuser-Busch people, they owned it. It was a great, big, beautiful place. And so Mike Lyman, he leased it. And he put his brother Abe in. And from there we went to the Ambassador Hotel. We were there for about eight years. And we got to making records. Gus was with us. Gus Miller, he was with us. At the Inn and down at the Ambassador.
